claim_ceiling: v17 adversarial test SUPPORTED (with nuance): cross-lingual legal_area label normalization on IDENTICAL embedding+machinery improves all three hierarchy-family purity metrics (hierarchy +20.2%, zoom fine +22.3%, legal_area +14.8%), satisfying the >=20% success rule on 2/3 metrics. v16 'pure data granularity' attribution was a mis-diagnosis; dominant cause is un-normalized cross-lingual label duplication (105->54 valid labels, -48%). Normalization does NOT flip benchmarks to PASS (hierarchy purity 0.389->0.467, still < 0.7); residual fine granularity + coarse umbrella labels still cap purity. v17b confirms effect is uniform across all 6 representations; relative product ranking NOT distorted; linear_hybrid05_concat benefits most (+24.0% hier). EXPLORATORY tier (correctly labeled). continue_recommended=false. Prior v16 results (run 33366069802) remain ACCEPTED and unaltered.

evidence_summary.v17b_uniformity: All 6 representations show improvement (ratios 1.127-1.277). uniform_improvement_or_matching=True. No representation worsened by >10%.
evidence_summary.v17b_v16_crossref: All 6 representations' v17b raw values match v16 benchmark JSON within 4e-7. Product ranking preserved.
evidence_summary.normalization_conservatism: 91-entry map merges only clear cross-lingual equivalents. Distinct topics remain distinct. Umbrella labels unchanged. Tests verify.
evidence_summary.label_count_cosmetic_error: state/evaluation.json claims 108 unique raw labels; actual count is 105 (metadata) or 104 (valid-only after benchmark filtering). Report text inherits the 108 figure. Non-material: core comparison uses benchmark-level counts (104->54).
evidence_summary.hypothesis_frozen: Hypothesis and success rule declared in script docstring before execution. Results saved atomically.
evidence_summary.negative_results_preserved: NMI decrease (0.5218->0.4881) and zoom improvement_pct worsening (-50.6%->-54.4%) both reported in detailed results. Normalization does NOT flip to PASS threshold: explicitly stated.
evidence_summary.file_integrity: v17 and v17b results JSONs byte-identical to their latest mirrors. All 7 state evidence references point to existing files. No claim-bearing results overwritten.

evidence_summary.no_data_leakage: Normalization map hand-crafted from external Swiss legal terminology knowledge, not learned from evaluation data.
evidence_summary.no_regressions: v17/v17b are additive experiments; v16 ACCEPTED results remain intact.
